subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Rakesh committed the mistake, and he must be__ convicted.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Acquitted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"convicted"** means to declare someone guilty of a criminal offense, usually after a legal trial. (दोषी ठहराया गया)

 
 
• **Example:** The jury convicted him of theft after reviewing all the evidence.
 
 
 
• **"Acquitted"** refers to being declared not guilty of a crime or wrongdoing, typically after a trial. (बरी किया गया)
 
 
• **Example:** The court acquitted her after finding no evidence against her.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'convicted'** is **'acquitted'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Acquitted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Punished** (दंडित): To inflict a penalty on someone for an offense, fault, or wrongdoing.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher punished the student for being late to class.
 
 
 
• **Sentenced** (सजा सुनाई गई): To declare the punishment decided for an offender, usually in a legal context.
 
 
• **Example:** He was sentenced to 10 years in prison for his crimes.
 
 
 
• **Crucified** (सलीब पर चढ़ाया गया): To severely punish or criticize someone, or literally, to execute by nailing to a cross.
 
 
• **Example:** The media crucified the politician over his recent scandal.
